description: christmas tree sugar cookies 🎄🌟 soft, buttery & sweet - save this recipe to bake this christmas!  the BEST sugar cookie recipe  1 cup unsalted butter, soft (not margarine)  1 cup granulated sugar  1 large egg  1 tsp vanilla extract  1 tsp almond extract  1/2 tsp baking powder  1/2 tsp salt  2 3/4 cups plain flour  buttercream recipe  1 cup unsalted butter, soft  3 1/2 cups of powdered sugar  1 tsp vanilla extract  2 tbsp whole milk  method  for the sugar cookies:  cream together the butter & sugar until light and fluffy add in all the other ingredients & stir into a cookie dough  roll out the dough & pop in the fridge for 30 minutes  cut out your cookie shapes & bake for 12-15 minutes until very lightly brown (oven set to 180c)
